coverage_note: About 75 URLs snapshotted; 22 product lines from 16 manufacturers, about 50 named models. Strong manufacturer sources: Thermo Vitrobot Mark IV, Leica (EM GP2, EM ICE, EM AFS2, EM VCT500), SPT chameleon, CryoSol VitroJet (manufacturer-hosted paper), Fischione 2550, Gatan CP3/626/915 manuals. Several lines rely on distributor or facility pages (Wohlwend Compact 02, ABRA HPM 010, CryoCapCell HPM Live µ, Quorum PP3010/PP3006, RMC FS-8500, Simple Origin). Gaps: gatan.com and ferrovac.com return HTTP 429 to the snapshot tool; quorumtech.com and cryosol-world.com/vitrojet need JavaScript; no datasheets for Wohlwend Compact 01/03/04, Vitrobot Mark III, Leica EM CPC or the HPM100 brochure, Gatan Alto 1000, Mel-Build, JEOL/Hitachi cryo-transfer, or Chinese domestic instruments. The WebSearch budget (200 per turn) and the Tavily plan limit ran out mid-run, so Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Indian makers and IVF vitrification devices were not searched exhaustively. Cryo-transfer TEM holders and Quorum cryo-SEM systems overlap other categories (some URLs were already cached by other agents).
